title: Adding to 10 | KG Maths for Kids | Little Takhti
description:
Learn to add up to 10 with mangoes, a number line hop and a ten frame, then try a quick quiz with Takhti.

Free printable worksheets, quizzes and games for this topic: https://littletakhti.netlify.app/kg-maths-adding-to-10-worksheets/

0:32 Number line
